summary: EFCAR, LLC, as depositor and registrant for Exeter Automobile Receivables Trust 2022-3, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Capital Contribution Agreement dated September 15, 2026, disclosed September 16, 2026. Exeter Finance LLC, EFCAR, LLC and auto-loan trusts 2022-2 through 2022-5 are parties, with Citibank, N.A., as indenture trustee, consenting. The agreement permits EFCAR to make certain limited capital contributions to each trust. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. This is a routine securitization structural document, not a special situation; watch for any credit-support draw implications.
